A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MTA research paper, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-F. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment.

before.justification: v1 reports original distillation experiments, benchmark scores, ablations, sensitivity analyses, and computational measurements in Sections 4-5 and Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons, component ablations, layer-schedule experiments, and computational measurements.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same word/phrase span construction, salience weighting, structural and hidden-representation alignment losses, and combined training objective.

E1.justification: Training on Dolly-15K and evaluation on Dolly, SelfInst, Vicuna, and S-NI are unchanged. Neither version adds or removes a task, domain, or test scenario.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same teacher, SFT, FDD, DistiLLM, and DistiLLM-2 comparisons and MTA variants. Comparator membership in the ablation and extended-training comparisons is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The teacher-student configurations, training budgets, fine-tuning procedures, ROUGE-L evaluation, GPT-4o-mini judging protocol, and time-matched controls are identical in both versions.

E4.justification: Section 5 and Appendix E retain identical analyses of loss components, word/phrase granularity, layer counts and schedules, computational efficiency, training budgets, and span weighting.

E5.justification: Appendix D specifies the same five generation seeds and averaged ROUGE-L reporting in both versions. No uncertainty estimates, repeated-run information, or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged, including Tables 1-7 and 12 and Figures 4-6. For example, the GPT-2 DistiLLM average remains 20.21 without MTA and 21.45 with MTA in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, and reasoning are identical, including Appendix C's token-importance formulas and Appendix D's layer-mapping rule. No assumptions, theorems, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about hierarchical trajectory alignment, modular integration into existing distillation methods, and empirical performance benefits.

C2.justification: Section 5's interpretations of the experimental findings are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning computational overhead and fixed computational budgets and benchmark settings.

D1.justification: Hardware and timing disclosures, implementation settings, hyperparameters, layer mappings, and the evaluation prompt remain unchanged in Section 5.4 and Appendices C-F. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning, including Appendix B's extended related work, are identical. Bibliography entries only move across columns and page boundaries.

P1.justification: The acknowledgment changes from project support under AFOSR award FA9550-23-S-0001 to support for Trung Le under AFOSR award FA2386-25-1-4023 and ARC grant DP250100262. The arXiv version/date stamp also updates; all other prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The revised acknowledgment causes local spacing changes and bibliography reflow across pages 10-12. All figures, tables, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 updates funding attribution and produces minor reference-layout changes. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information are identical, so these administrative edits do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
